subject.title: feat: add opt-in OpenTelemetry to chat turns and transcript loading

question: Should the tray adopt this six-span and thirteen-metric chat lifecycle taxonomy as a supported long-term observability contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but signal names, cardinality boundaries, lifecycle ownership, and maintenance cost become product-level operational contracts that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve after current-head proof
options.body: Accept the proposed taxonomy once collector evidence from `4203fb72` demonstrates representative local, remote, history, and terminal paths with privacy-safe attributes.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the initial contract to turn duration, first-response latency, terminal outcome, and history-load timing, deferring detailed phase and dropped-event signals until operator demand is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Approve after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed taxonomy once collector evidence from `4203fb72` demonstrates representative local, remote, history, and terminal paths with privacy-safe attributes.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available public project-routing candidate for deciding whether this observability surface should become a supported tray contract.
